title: My Healthy Habits
text:
Healthy habits help us feel good every day. I eat fruit and vegetables at lunch. I also drink water when I am thirsty. My friend Ana likes to walk to school.

Sleep is important too. I go to bed at nine o'clock. Good sleep gives me energy for school. On weekends, I play outside with my brother.

questions.text: What does the writer eat at lunch?
What time does the writer go to bed?
Why is sleep important for the writer?
options: It helps the writer win games
It is only needed by adults

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer's weekends?
options: The writer is active and likes being outdoors
The writer stays inside all day
The writer works at a restaurant
The writer does not have a brother

vocabulary.definition: plants or parts of plants that we eat as food, such as carrots
the strength to do things, such as play or study

paragraph_translations: Los hábitos saludables nos ayudan a sentirnos bien todos los días. Como fruta y verduras en el almuerzo. También bebo agua cuando tengo sed. A mi amiga Ana le gusta caminar a la escuela.
El sueño también es importante. Me acuesto a las nueve en punto. Dormir bien me da energía para la escuela. Los fines de semana juego afuera con mi hermano.
